query:
SELECT ARRAY(
                SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(r.request->'allowed_tools', '[]'::jsonb))
            ) AS "tools!"
           FROM agent_runs r
           JOIN agent_farm_runs f ON f.agent_run_id = r.id
           WHERE r.gateway_session_id = $1
           ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
           LIMIT 1
